**Cause:** `OrdersPage.__init__` registered a handler only for `refresh`. Clicking "export" found no handler and returned silently. The existing test called `page.export()` directly, so it never exercised the button and passed anyway.

**Test** (`tests/test_orders_web.py`): added `test_export_button_writes_one_download`, which clicks `"export"` instead of calling the method. I confirmed it reproduced the bug (0 downloads) before the fix and 1 download after.

`python3 -m unittest` runs 9 tests, all passing.

I left your uncommitted `README.md` change and the `notes/` directory out of the commit. The commit message ends with the Haiku 5.5 co-author line from the attribution reminder.

Your README has a note asking whether Export should include cancelled orders. I didn't change that behavior, since the orders data has no cancelled status to filter on. The export currently includes every order in the page.
